entries.subject: Gemini Observatory archive access
entries.finding: The Gemini archive refused this project's requests on 2026-09-17 (403 to both its JSON search and its search form, with and without a browser user agent). CADC mirrors Gemini data and answered anonymously (200), so Gemini data are reachable through CADC.
entries.revisitWhen: A body or star in this repository needs data from this facility.
